mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor expectations toward future monetary policy accommodation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the likelihood of a near-term Federal Reserve rate cut, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect (joint signal) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.0 over two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a Fed policy response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over a 3-month window signals a tightening cycle, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) over the past four months indicates strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 130,000 over the past month signals labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of a Fed rate cut, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS falls below 130,000, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% over the past three months, combined with a low federal funds rate, signals that the Fed may delay rate hikes, increasing the risk of overheating and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
